purpose: Check that preflight guidance produces auditable, model-agnostic work records.

expected: Postflight records each lane as subagent, checklist, not_applicable, or not_run.

must_not_claim: Do not claim a model complied unless the session record shows the required steps.
Do not treat preflight output as permission to mutate another repo.
promotion_gate: Promote only after Codex, Claude, Cursor, and checklist-only flows can all record the same lane statuses.
